title: Malioboro Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Malioboro Run review: 7,000 runners through Yogyakarta's heritage core on 5 October 2025, an AIMS-measured route, and places that sold out in two days.
dek: Yogyakarta's bank-backed heritage run took 7,000 runners from Kepatihan through Malioboro, the Kraton and Kotabaru in October 2025. Here is what that edition was like.
verdict: Malioboro Run is a heritage run through the centre of Yogyakarta. The 2025 edition, its fourth, on Sunday 5 October, was capped at 7,000 runners, and the places sold out within two days [1][2]. The route started and finished at the Kepatihan provincial government complex and ran along Jalan Malioboro, past Vredeburg Fort and Titik Nol, through the Kraton quarter, Kotabaru and on to Panggung Krapyak [1][2]. The course was standardised by AIMS, and the organisers added start corrals for runners chasing a time [1][2]. If you want a half marathon or 10 km that shows you Yogyakarta, enter as soon as registration opens.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: Malioboro Run 2025 was held on Sunday 5 October, starting and finishing at the Kepatihan complex, the Yogyakarta provincial government office [1][2]. It is organised by the regional bank BPD DIY and had run every year since 2022 [1][2].

The field was capped at 7,000: 1,070 in the half marathon, 2,600 in the 10 km and 3,330 in the 5 km [2]. The organiser said tickets sold out within two days [1], and 73% of registered runners came from outside the Yogyakarta region [2].

sections.heading: A Route Through the Old City
paragraphs: The route was designed as a tour of Yogyakarta's heritage: Jalan Malioboro, Vredeburg Fort, the Titik Nol Kilometer, the Plengkung Tarunasuro (Wijilan) gate, the Njeron Beteng area inside the Kraton walls, the colonial Kotabaru district and Panggung Krapyak [1][2].

For 2025 the organisers had the course standardised by AIMS, added start corrals for runners chasing a personal best, split categories into open and masters, and switched registration to a queueing system [1][2]. The bank's president director said the AIMS certification also covered distance and standards for handling accidents, with hospitals involved [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a city race in Indonesia where the route is the reason to go. The half-marathon route packs in a remarkable amount of the city's history.
Be ready for registration. With places capped and gone in two days in 2025, you need to be online when entries open.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition, most of it from just before race day. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
